title: SpecEvo: Speculative Evolution with Large Language Models for Cost-Efficient Scientific Discovery
abstract: arXiv:2610.28706v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: LLM-driven evolutionary search is a promising paradigm for scientific discovery, but existing methods remain costly and slow, often applying expensive reasoning uniformly while underusing evidence from failed, redundant, and saturated trials. We introduce Speculative Evolution (SpecEvo), a multi-LLM framework that coordinates lightweight and frontier models through continual consolidation of search evidence. Lightweight models power both parallel Speculators, which generate and refine candidate programs, and an Advisor, which distills accumulated successes, failures, and saturated directions into persistent guidance for subsequent exploration. At sparse checkpoints, a frontier-model Navigator inspects the evolving population and intervenes through synthesis, surgical refinement, or reframing according to search stagnation. This speculate-then-consolidate workflow delegates routine exploration and evidence consolidation to inexpensive mod

translated_title: SpecEvo：基于大语言模型的投机进化实现高性价比科学发现
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）驱动的进化搜索是科学发现的一种有前景的范式，但现有方法成本高昂且速度缓慢，往往不加区分地应用昂贵推理，同时未能充分利用来自失败、冗余和饱和试验的证据。我们提出了投机进化（SpecEvo），这是一个多LLM框架，通过持续整合搜索证据来协调轻量级模型与前沿模型。轻量级模型既驱动并行的“投机器”——用于生成和改进候选程序，也驱动一个“顾问”——将积累的成功、失败和饱和方向提炼为对后续探索的持久指导。在稀疏的检查点处，由前沿模型充当的“领航员”审视不断进化的种群，并根据搜索停滞情况通过综合、精准改进或问题重构进行干预。这种“先投机后整合”的工作流程将常规探索和证据整合交给低成本的模型（注：摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: SpecEvo提出多LLM协作的“投机-整合”框架，由轻量级模型承担日常探索与证据整合、前沿模型仅在关键检查点介入干预，从而大幅降低LLM进化搜索用于科学发现的计算成本。
en_tdlr: SpecEvo is a multi-LLM "speculate-then-consolidate" framework that delegates routine exploration and evidence consolidation to lightweight models while frontier models intervene only at sparse checkpoints, achieving cost-efficient LLM-driven evolutionary search for scientific discovery.
